claims.statement: First release exports one chart per action.
Offer both Copy image (clipboard) and Download image (file).
The image contains everything visible for the chart itself; no advanced mode, captions, or source line for now.
Default size is the on-screen size at 2x.
Bounded charts export at full extent; the raw data table exports only visible rows; pivot and summary tables export in full.
Selection emphasis is preserved; hover tooltips and editor UI are excluded.
Export uses the current theme.
Every family gets the actions; families that cannot capture say so instead of producing broken output. 3D exports the current camera view; maps export as drawn.
Entry points: chart header menu, right-click on chart, keyboard shortcut.
Composition moves onto the shared actions and function.
Public function exportChartPng(chartId) returns a PNG Blob with size for a mounted chart.
Whole-report PPTX/PDF and export-everything are out of scope.
Rendering charts to PNG without an initialized client is captured as a separate seed.
Expose exportChartPng as a method on ExplorEdaHandle, scoped to its workspace.

shape.appetite: One capability: several entry points over one capture core; no new settings, saved state, or layout changes.
shape.problem: Analysts paste charts into ongoing work but only composition can produce an image today.
shape.recommended_shape: One captureChart(chartId) seam with per-family capture strategies (generic DOM-panel rasterizer, composition artboard, WebGL frame grab); Copy, Download, context menu, shortcut, and ExplorEdaHandle.exportChartPng are thin wrappers. Capture from the live mounted chart.
success_moves: Single capture seam so every entry point and the public API share one path and one not-capturable flag.
Capture the live chart rather than re-rendering offscreen; offscreen rendering belongs to the headless seed.
Prove the generic rasterizer on the hardest common case (Canvas + SVG + HTML legend + dark theme + selection) before committing to it.
Ship a family disabled with a reason rather than degraded when its fidelity check fails.
Reuse the composition artboardPng path as one strategy instead of a parallel feature.
Download is the always-works fallback when the clipboard API is unavailable.

first_proof.question: Does a generic DOM-panel rasterizer reproduce a mixed Canvas/SVG/HTML chart faithfully in the current theme?
first_proof.artifact: PNG of a dark-theme scatter with title, subtitle, HTML legend, annotation, and brushed selection, compared side by side with the screen (fonts, text bounds, canvas alignment, legend, dimming, no controls).
first_proof.decision_rule: Match → generic rasterizer is the default strategy, only WebGL and composition get their own; drift in fonts or HTML layout → per-family compositors and re-scoped coverage.
first_proof.result: Passed in Chromium 2026-10-11: ≤0.3% pixel mismatch for scatter (dark, HTML legend, annotations, brush), parallel coordinates, maps, light scatter. Required: data: URL (blob URL tainted with foreignObject), embedded @font-face (host Plex fell back and clipped title without), explicit omit markers (tag-based hiding removed legend buttons), WebGL render-then-read (blank without preserveDrawingBuffer). Safari/Firefox unverified.

rabbit_holes: Fonts and CSS variables not resolving inside an SVG foreignObject image.
WebGL 3D renderer lacks preserveDrawingBuffer; needs render-then-read.
Full-extent measurement of scrolled bounded charts without changing saved layout.
Clipboard gesture requirement for keyboard and context-menu entry points.
Possible new dependency (html-to-image or similar) versus an in-house rasterizer.
open_decisions: Browser coverage: WebKit/Gecko may need a composite fallback strategy.
